title: Built a complete 2.5D tilemap editor and rendering engine using Opus 4.6 in one day using free asset pack. Now adding RTS multiplayer mechanics. Targetting early access by tomorrow, release by Wednesday 🫡 (only slightly kidding)
author: zebleck

comments.author: angrydeanerino
comments.body: Cool, you wanna share how or nah?

replies.author: zebleck
replies.body:
Sure! Inspired by this video: [https://youtu.be/6uzACGCS8ko?si=VUEBx6qSfzrt4m39](https://youtu.be/6uzACGCS8ko?si=VUEBx6qSfzrt4m39)

  
I wanted to replicate its ability to build a RTS game since Ive wanted to build one for a long time but havent found the time. Basically you download a free asset pack and give it Claude Code a prompt to build an RTS game and integrate the asset pack. I added the additional feature of it needing mutplayer. It basically oneshot the entire game, with websocket networking, resource extraction, fighting mechanics etc. But the collision detection and map were very simple so I decided to restart from scratch and first build a level editor. This needed a lot of manual iteration and explaining to Claude how the tile system works for this particular asset pack, because it was struggling with visual understanding and putting the pieces in the spritesheets together, especially the different height levels. However, after carefully explaining it slowly got it and we got this working prototype, which perfectly replicates the official island from the asset pack website.
